candidate.title: DNA methylation age of human tissues and cell types
candidate.abstract: It is not yet known whether DNA methylation levels can be used to accurately predict age across a broad spectrum of human tissues and cell types, nor whether the resulting age prediction is a biologically meaningful measure. I developed a multi-tissue predictor of age that allows one to estimate the DNA methylation age of most tissues and cell types. The predictor, which is freely available, was developed using 8,000 samples from 82 Illumina DNA methylation array datasets, encompassing 51 healthy tissues and cell types. I found that DNA methylation age has the following properties: first, it is close to zero for embryonic and induced pluripotent stem cells; second, it correlates with cell passage number; third, it gives rise to a highly heritable measure of age acceleration; and, fourth, it is applicable to chimpanzee tissues. Analysis of 6,000 cancer samples from 32 datasets showed that all of the considered 20 cancer types exhibit significant age acceleration, with an average of 36 years. Low age-acceleration of cancer tissue is associated with a high number of somatic mutations and TP53 mutations, while mutations in steroid receptors greatly accelerate DNA methylation age in breast cancer. Finally, I characterize the 353 CpG sites that together form an aging clock in terms of chromatin states and tissue variance. I propose that DNA methylation age measures the cumulative effect of an epigenetic maintenance system. This novel epigenetic clock can be used to address a host of questions in developmental biology, cancer and aging research.

panel.reason: 多组织DNA甲基化时钟奠基工作，系数公开，跨82数据集。
多组织DNA甲基化时钟开山之作，公开系数，领域必读

extraction.method: 弹性网络回归选353个CpG构建多组织DNAm年龄预测器
extraction.data: Illumina 27K/450K DNA甲基化，7844非癌样本，82数据集，51组织/细胞类型
extraction.scenario: 跨组织/细胞类型预测年龄
extraction.benchmark: 既往单组织DNAm年龄预测器（如唾液/血液）
extraction.results: 测试误差3.6年；DNAm年龄与 chronological age 高度相关；早衰症不符合正常衰老；iPS重编程将表观时钟重置为0
extraction.availability: 公开DNA甲基化数据集；预测器/代码未明确
extraction.limitations: 仅用21,369个两平台共有CpG；训练/测试数据异质性；癌症组织排除；组织类型覆盖仍有限
extraction.summary: 该研究构建了一个跨组织、细胞类型的DNA甲基化年龄预测器。作者整合82个公开Illumina 27K/450K数据集、7844个非癌样本，用弹性网络回归从21,369个CpG中选出353个时钟CpG。结果显示该DNAm年龄在多数组织中预测误差约3.6年，并可揭示早衰症和iPS重编程等衰老相关现象。
